body.name: \(\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{crit}}\)
body.construction:
Pull the inner equation and the generated-target equation into treated-post coordinates as in def:nested-derivative, retaining \(\mathcal H_P\).  For every outer pole \(y\), let \(G_B(y,\cdot)\) be the mean-zero Green function and set
\[
 w_y=G_B(y,\cdot)-\chi_y\Gamma_{B(y)}(\cdot-y)
      -\int_{\mathbb T^2}\{G_B(y,z)-\chi_y(z)\Gamma_{B(y)}(z-y)\}\,dz,
\]
where \(\chi_y\) is a fixed translated cutoff and
\[
 \Gamma_{B(y)}(z-y)=-\frac{1}{2\pi\sqrt{\det B(y)}}
 \log\lVert B(y)^{-1/2}(z-y)\rVert.
\]
Use the weak equation for \(w_y\), whose singular forcing is
\(\operatorname{div}((B-B(y))\chi_y\nabla\Gamma_{B(y)})\) plus smooth cutoff terms, and use coercivity and the torus Poincar\'e inequality to bound \(\lVert\nabla w_y\rVert_2\).  Use the separate pointwise Green bound \(\lVert\nabla G_B(y,z)\rVert\lesssim d(y,z)^{-1}\) for fourth moments.  Change variables through each pullback before applying Young's inequality.  Control pilot coefficient errors by uniform H\"older convergence and moving-pole errors by an \(o_{\mathbb P}(h_n)\) pole rate.  Close the nested stochastic expansion with the mixed tame remainder
\[
 \lVert R_P(u)\rVert\leq C
 \max_g\lVert u_g\rVert_{C^{1,1/4}}
 \max_g\lVert u_g\rVert_{C^{0,1/4}}.
\]
